title: Strip setgid bits from Windows VM mount sources
body: Closes https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/issues/10399 ## Summary `omarchy windows vm launch` failed when `~/Windows` had a leftover setgid bit (mode 2700). Octal `chmod 0700` through `/proc/$pid/fd` does not clear `S_ISGID` on some filesystems, so the privacy guard aborted after the VM had already started. Clear setuid/setgid symbolically first, then set 0700, and print the observed modes if the guard still fails. ## Test plan ```bash bash test/shell.d/windows-vm-test.sh bash test/shell.d/windows-vm-compose-test.sh ```

title: Keep an existing wine package when installing Lutris
body: Closes https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/issues/11301 ## Summary `omarchy install gaming lutris` always installed `wine-staging`, which conflicts with `wine`. If wine was already present the whole install aborted. Use the installed wine provider when one exists; otherwise keep preferring wine-staging. ## Test plan ```bash bash test/shell.d/lutris-install-test.sh ```

title: Install matching kernel headers before broadcom-wl-dkms
body: Closes https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/issues/10975 ## Summary The 4.0.3 upgrade swapped `broadcom-wl` for `broadcom-wl-dkms` without headers on stock `linux` (older MacBooks). The module never built, so Wi-Fi died after reboot. Install matching headers in `fix-bcm43xx.sh`, and repair existing DKMS installs with a migration that covers `linux` / `linux-lts` as well as Omarchy/T2 kernels. ## Test plan ```bash bash test/shell.d/bcm43xx-headers-test.sh ```

title: Do not use muted as a VS Code button fill
body: Closes https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/issues/9982 ## Summary Generated VS Code themes used `muted` for comment text *and* as the fill behind `foreground` labels (`button.secondaryBackground`, `commandCenter.activeBackground`, `extensionButton.background`). Comments then failed WCAG contrast on several stock palettes. Keep `muted` for comments; derive those fills from `mix background foreground`. ## Test plan ```bash bash test/shell.d/vscode-theme-test.sh ```

title: Paint wall-clock time as soon as the clock widget loads
body: Closes https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/issues/10822 ## Summary The bar clock bound `displayDate` to `SystemClock.date` and only refreshed on `onDateChanged`. Until the first tick it could show a stale time (reported as the time from last session, for 10–20 seconds). Set `displayDate` from `new Date()` on completion so the first paint is current. ## Test plan ```bash bash test/shell.d/clock-test.sh ```

title: Point at the running update log when the lock is held
body: Closes https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/issues/10879 ## Summary If the update terminal disappeared (KVM switch, lid close), a second `omarchy update` only said "already running" with no way to see progress. When `/tmp/omarchy-update.log` exists, print `tail -f /tmp/omarchy-update.log`. ## Test plan ```bash bash test/shell.d/update-lock-test.sh ```
